newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak c.bank crown/dollar fix at 34.515 (34.544).
newsitem.headline: Slovak c.bank crown/dollar fix at 34.515 (34.544).

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) fixed the crown at 34.515 to the dollar on Thursday after Wednesday's fixing at 34.544 and at 18.886 to the mark from 18.891.
The crown fixing is announced daily at about 1140 CET (1040 GMT) and is within plus/minus 7.0 percent of a dollar/mark basket midpoint calculated at exactly 11:30:00 CET.
The above rates imply a deviation from the midpoint of 0.25 percent, after a deviation of -0.31 percent on Wednesday.
At the time of the calculation, the crown was trading on the interbank market at -0.13 versus the basket.
